desc:
DELICIOUS TASTE: Made with real cinnamon, each box of crunchy lattice squares brings an irresistibly cinnamon-y taste your whole family can enjoy; Keep a box in your pantry for a morning food that's ready to eat any time

WHOLE GRAIN: Helps get your day off to a good start with 13g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

GLUTEN FREE CEREAL: Pour some in a bowl with milk for a great-tasting, gluten free part of an easy breakfast; Pack some in a lunch box or backpack for snacks on the go; Add to homemade cereal bars as snacks for kids

VITAMINS AND MINERALS: Beyond the delicious taste, every serving is a good source of 12 vitamins and minerals, and made without high fructose corn syrup, or artificial flavors or colors

CONTAINS: One 12 oz box of Cinnamon Flavored Chex Cereal
features:
Features

Warm Cinnamon Flavor
Each crunchy square is lightly coated with real cinnamon and sugar for a comforting, sweet start to your day.

Made with Whole Grain Rice
Provides 13 grams of whole grain per serving to support a balanced diet.

100% Gluten-Free
A safe and tasty option for those with gluten sensitivities or celiac diets.

No Artificial Flavors, Colors, or High-Fructose Corn Syrup
Clean label ingredients you can feel good about.

Fortified with 12 Essential Vitamins and Minerals
Supports daily nutrition with nutrients like iron, zinc, vitamin D, and B vitamins.

Kosher Certified
Suitable for various dietary lifestyles and preferences.

Benefits

Delicious and Wholesome Breakfast
Combines the sweetness of cinnamon with the crunch of Chex for a satisfying morning meal or snack.

Nutritious Snacking Anytime
Great dry as a grab-and-go snack, or used in trail mixes, lunchboxes, or baking recipes.

Supports Daily Nutrition
Fortification ensures you're getting more than just taste—it's packed with important nutrients.

Family-Friendly Flavor
Loved by both kids and adults for its mild sweetness and crisp texture.

Meal Prep Friendly
Keeps well in resealable packaging and fits into busy routines with ease.

Versatile Use
Perfect as cereal with milk, mixed into yogurt, or used in no-bake desserts and snack bars.
ingredients: Whole Grain Rice, Rice, Sugar, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, Cinnamon, Molasses, Rosemary Extract, Natural Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Tricalcium Phosphate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
